title: RecoverBench Trajectory Schema V1
description: Standardized canonical schema for individual agent execution trajectories under RecoverBench.

pair_id.description: Optional paired trial identifier linking control and fault runs.

domain.description: Task domain (payments, database, git, cloud, etc.).

condition.description: Execution condition: failure-free CONTROL or injected FAULT.

agent_name.description: Name or identifier of the evaluated agent.

model_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of model weights/manifest if available.

recovery_method.description: Recovery substrate applied (or none if handled natively by agent).

seed.description: Random seed used for sampling and perturbations.

messages.description: Conversation message history visible to the agent.

tool_calls.description: Chronological list of tool invocations dispatched by the agent.

tool_results.description: Chronological list of outputs or errors received from tools.

latency_ms.description: Total execution wall-clock time in milliseconds.

fault_visible_observations.description: Explicit fault observations seen by the agent (e.g. connection timeout).

benchmark_hidden_trace.description: Evaluator-private trace containing ground-truth effect logs and oracle verdicts.
